text:
maria: Heads up — staging promote blocked, deploy-bot flagged artifact upload failing with multipart uploads aborting to S3. Hits 3/3 retries.
ci-bot: job `ci/upload-artifacts` failed: MultipartUploadAbortedError — part ETag mismatch on part 2. Logs show `AbortMultipartUpload` and 500s.
kevin: Is this the same S3 flake we saw last month? region us-east-1? any networking churn?
sam: not the same pattern. This one looks like consistent 500s from runner node-17 during part uploads, not intermittent single request failures. Retry sometimes clears it.
release-manager: we have the change window at 15:30 UTC. If we can't clear the promote before then we either pin to previous image or rollback the canary. What does ops want?
deploy-bot: Promotion blocked: artifact-upload-failure (code: ART_UPLOAD_504). Manual override requires `release-manager` approval.
maria: can we ask deploy-bot to skip artifact validation just for this canary? we still have signed TUF metadata and the artifact exists on the build machine. Risky though.
kevin: don't skip validation. Suggest: re-run upload job on the runner pool `fast-upload` (better network path) and verify checksum against the build metadata. I'll trigger a rerun.
sam: copying log snippet from runner node-17:
```
Uploading part 2/4 to s3://redwood-artifacts/staging/abc-202603.json.part
ERROR: 500 InternalError
AbortMultipartUpload: Request aborted by server
\n```
ci-bot: re-run started: `ci/upload-artifacts (retry #1)` by kevin at 2620012400.
maria: if re-run fails again, fallback plan A: pin release to previous image tag `v2026-03-10-rc3` and proceed with the change window. That requires ops and release-manager signoff.
release-manager: @tim (ops oncall) can you confirm we can pin and proceed through the change window if rerun fails? Otherwise we'll have to rollback the canary.
tim: oncall — pinning is acceptable for this window but we need a postmortem and follow-up. Approve manual promote only after checksum verification.
kevin: re-run finished at 2620012540 — upload succeeded on `fast-upload-3` runner. Checksum from s3: `sha256:abcd1234ef567890...` matches the build metadata checksum.
deploy-bot: Promotion unblocked. Proceeding with canary promote to staging. (actioned by deploy-bot at 2620012560)
release-manager: adding a short note for release notes & postmortem: "staging promote briefly blocked by multipart S3 uploads; manual re-upload and checksum verification performed; pinned fallback approved but not required."
maria: thanks all. I'll update the release notes and create a JIRA for a deeper investigation into runner network path and S3 multipart stability. Closing thread.
